dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds concrete expert thresholds (CPU<30% & Memory<50% for downsize, CPU>70% or Memory>80% for upsize), explicit network‑utilization formula, burst‑credit math, Graviton compatibility matrix, pricing‑model decision tree and detailed instance‑family mapping. Missing newer Graviton4 families and region‑specific pricing nuances, so not a full 20.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes senior‑engineer mindset (cost‑quality trade‑off, data‑gate first) and AWS‑specific procedures (CLI commands for CloudWatch, EC2, Compute Optimizer, Savings Plans, confirmation gates, batch limits). Lacks an explicit pre‑check that the target instance type is available in the desired AZ before migration.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains an extensive NEVER list with concrete reasoning (memory‑only downsizing, Spot for stateful workloads, Graviton compatibility, burst‑credit cliffs, RI exchange limits, etc.). Missing explicit warnings about IAM permission failures and the need to check Spot Placement Scores before Spot recommendations.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Front‑matter, description, when_to_use, activation_triggers, and invocation_schema are all present and well‑formed. The "when_to_use" narrative is a bit verbose, causing slight ambiguity about exact trigger boundaries.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Top‑level quick‑start gives concise guidance; deeper sections (philosophy, pre‑flight, detailed process, anti‑patterns) are revealed later. Some critical formulas (network limit calculation, credit math) are buried deep, causing slight cognitive overload.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are tightly constrained: mandatory CONFIRM gate, snapshot before change, batch size limit of 5, rollback steps, off‑peak scheduling, and explicit safety checks for each data source. Calibration matches fragility perfectly.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable structure (quick start → mindset → philosophy → reference → pre‑flight → process → output format → anti‑patterns). Minor ad‑hoc ordering of some sections prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides decision trees, working CLI snippets, error‑handling branches, and concrete example outputs that an agent can execute. Lacks explicit integration of Spot Placement Score in Spot recommendations and some edge‑case handling (e.g., stale Compute Optimizer data) which reduces usability slightly.
